name: Modal / Create Project
description: Create Project product scenario for the Modal component.

props.title: Create project
props.description: Start from a blank workspace or a template.
props.children: Project name, region, and environment settings.

controls.name: open
controls.description: Whether the dialog is open; updates from the parent never call onOpenChange.

controls.name: defaultOpen
controls.description: Whether the dialog is open on mount when `open` is not set; read once.

controls.name: trigger
controls.description: Element that opens the dialog, keeping its own props and ref; text renders as a Button.

controls.name: title
controls.description: Heading of the dialog, which also gives the dialog its accessible name.

controls.name: description
controls.description: Text under the title, announced as the dialog's description.

controls.name: children
controls.description: Body of the dialog, mounted while it is open; text renders as body copy.

controls.name: footer
controls.description: Region under the body, aligned to the end, usually the dialog's buttons; they close nothing on their own.

controls.name: closable
controls.description: Shows the close button and lets Escape and backdrop presses close the dialog; false leaves closing to its own controls.

controls.name: closeOnBackdropClick
controls.description: A press on the backdrop closes the dialog; ignored while `closable` is false.

controls.name: labels
controls.description: Names of the dialog's own controls.

controls.name: placement
controls.description: Where the surface sits: centered, or against the start, end, top or bottom edge; start and end follow the direction.

controls.name: edge
controls.description: Edge placements only: `inset` keeps a gap with rounded, bordered corners; `flush` touches the edge, square and borderless.

controls.name: width
controls.description: Surface width in pixels, capped by the viewport.

controls.name: height
controls.description: Surface height in pixels, capped by the viewport.

controls.name: scrollLock
controls.description: Stops the page behind the open dialog from scrolling; off by default, and ignored when `portal` is false.

controls.name: portal
controls.description: Renders into document.body as a modal layer; false renders a static preview inside the parent that leaves the page, keys and focus alone.
